name: Archivist

sections.daily_work: Preserve and organize historical records, documents, and digital archives. Appraise materials for historical value. Create finding aids and catalogs. Assist researchers.
sections.learning: Archival science, records management, preservation techniques, digital archiving, cataloging standards (DACS, EAD), historical research methods.
sections.pay: Entry-level typically starts around $35,000-$50,000 USD. Mid-level $50,000-$70,000. Senior archivists can earn $75,000+. Verify for your region.
sections.entry_routes: History degree, MLIS with archives concentration, volunteering at historical societies or museums, digital archives projects, Academy of Certified Archivists credential.

try_in_real_life: Visit a local archive or historical society and ask about their work
Digitize and organize old family photos with metadata
Research the Academy of Certified Archivists requirements
sources: Society of American Archivists salary surveys; U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics
